title: Bicycle Commute
description: Cycle to work, school, or errands instead of taking a motorized vehicle.

title: Public Transit Ride
description: Take the public bus, metro, or local train for your daily travel.

title: Proper Garbage Disposal
description: Segregate dry, wet, and recyclable waste and dispose of them responsibly.

title: Feed Stray Animals
description: Provide clean water and healthy food to stray animals or birds in your neighborhood.

title: Plant or Care for a Sapling
description: Plant a new sapling or water and prune existing plants in your garden or locality.

title: Reusable Bag Shopping
description: Use your own cloth or jute reusable bag for grocery or retail shopping.

title: Carry Reusable Bottle / Mug
description: Carry and refill your own reusable water bottle or thermos throughout the day.

title: Kitchen Waste Composting
description: Compost fruit peels, vegetable scraps, and tea leaves to create organic fertilizer.

title: Walk for Short Trips
description: Walk instead of driving or booking a cab for trips under 2 km.

title: Power Down Idle Electronics
description: Turn off idle lights, fans, and unplug phantom power consumers before leaving.
